order: Fix all four findings from the latest cross-vendor review round and record its verdict. Make the touches lint compare path elements one by one rather than joining them into a collision-prone comma string. Have the deep-plan glob matcher reproduce the retired regular expression's line-terminator classes exactly, so the replacement matches what its predecessor matched. Give the checkout module a startup sweep that reclaims abandoned worktrees whose directories are still on disk, since pruning alone clears only the registrations whose directory has already gone missing, and keep the checkouts this process is actively using exempt from that sweep. Correct the wording future review orders use, so an order enumerates every commit inside its pinned range and never describes that range as a single commit. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster, hold the tranche at REVISE pending the next round, and leave the suites green.
claims: All four findings are addressed, with the touches lint comparing elements, the glob matcher reproducing the retired pattern's line-terminator classes, the checkout module sweeping abandoned worktrees at startup with the ones in active use exempt, and the review-order wording calling for every commit in a pinned range. The review verdict lands, recorded verbatim in the roster. All three suites were re-run green alongside the four fixes, with router fully passing, verifier at 94 passed, and registry at 31 passed.
